<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Pummeling Whirlpool](/Feats.aspx?ID=5357) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=732" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 39

**Frequency**
once per day

</column>

---

You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation (or 15 feet if you're in a body of water) takes 8d6 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88). At 17th level, the damage increases to 11d6.
name: Pummeling Whirlpool
